$DRY_RUN_CMD mkdir -p "$HOME/.kiro/settings"
settings="$HOME/.kiro/settings/mcp.json"
$DRY_RUN_CMD rm -f "$HOME/.kiro/mcp-models.md"
# First deploy (missing or still a store symlink): drop the generated file verbatim.
if [[ ! -f "$settings" ]] || [[ -L "$settings" ]]; then
  $DRY_RUN_CMD rm -f "$settings"
  $DRY_RUN_CMD cp /nix/store/lh5lq3gjjg22rn8sjpygwga1mmhxbzyd-kiro-mcp.json "$settings"
  $DRY_RUN_CMD chmod 644 "$settings"
else
  # Subsequent rebuilds: merge. Flake wins on wiring; existing file keeps
  # its per-server runtime flags and any user-only servers.
  tmp="$(mktemp "/tmp/mcp-merge.XXXXXX")"
  /nix/store/9h51kaz0zibf2fihxp3fnccdf50rlcvh-jq-1.8.2-bin/bin/jq -s '
    (.[0].mcpServers) as $flake
    | (.[1].mcpServers // {}) as $live
    | . as $both
    | {
        mcpServers: (
          # Start from every server name in either source.
          (($flake | keys) + ($live | keys) | unique)
          | map(. as $name | {
              key: $name,
              value: (
                ($flake[$name]) as $f
                | ($live[$name]) as $l
                | if $f == null then $l            # user-only server: keep as-is
                  elif $l == null then $f           # new flake server: take flake wiring
                  else                              # in both: flake wiring + preserved user flags
                    $f
                    + (if $l.disabled != null then { disabled: $l.disabled } else {} end)
                        + (if $l.autoApprove != null then { autoApprove: $l.autoApprove } else {} end)
                        + (if $l.disabledTools != null then { disabledTools: $l.disabledTools } else {} end)
                  end
              )
            })
          | from_entries
        )
      }
  ' /nix/store/lh5lq3gjjg22rn8sjpygwga1mmhxbzyd-kiro-mcp.json "$settings" > "$tmp"
  $DRY_RUN_CMD mv "$tmp" "$settings"
  $DRY_RUN_CMD chmod 644 "$settings"
fi
